blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Mayor Nestor Archival must pay a fine equivalent to one month of his basic salary after the Office of the Ombudsman found him administratively liable for failing to ensure compliance with legal requirements in the operation of the Colon Street Night Market in 2025.
